title:
A fenced code block in parsed Markdown, specificially for Mermaid diagrams.

For example:

    ```mermaid
    sequenceDiagram
        Q->>A: What kind of phone does a mermaid use?
        A->>Q: A shell phone!
    ```

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    Q->>A: What kind of phone does a mermaid use?
    A->>Q: A shell phone!
```

Note that for this to render correctly, the Mermaid library must be loaded into the page hosting the HTML.

Also, like other Markdown elements, HTML tags are not supported.

@see https://mermaid.js.org/intro/
name: MarkdownMermaid
